entities.name: Indira Banerjee
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Indira Banerjee is a retired Indian jurist who served as a judge of the Supreme Court of India and the eighth female judge in history of the Indian Supreme Court. Previously, she served as chief justice of the Madras High Court, the second woman to hold the position.
